_note: Inputs for the three orphan checks. (a) liveVolumeIds = aws ec2 describe-volumes --query 'Volumes[].VolumeId' (ALL volume states, per region): a snapshot whose VolumeId is in this list has a live source volume. (b) amiSnapshotRefs = aws ec2 describe-images --owners self --query 'Images[].BlockDeviceMappings[].Ebs.SnapshotId': a snapshot in this list backs an AMI. (c) managed-by-policy is read from each snapshot's own Tags/Description in snapshots-older-than-30d.json: tag aws:backup:source-resource or Description 'This snapshot is created by the AWS Backup service' (AWS Backup); tag dlm:managed=true or Description starting 'Created for policy:' (DLM). A snapshot is an ORPHAN CANDIDATE only if it fails all three: source volume gone, no AMI reference, not policy-managed.
